avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft) 22 to 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 30 (2024), June 1 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft).

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: 28.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 54.9 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 54.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: 18.8 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 33.8 in (2023), 24.6 in (2024), 35.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 29 and June 20, carried from the melt-out dates at Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 718 ft below the pass; points to May 6 to June 28

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 558 ft below the pass; points to April 22 to June 12
